## Scope

Describe the behavior/documentation change and its hardware identity scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit/build checks passed.
- [ ] No hosted CI or PR workflow runs hardware gates.
- [ ] If write scope changed: reversible live evidence, readback, and restoration are documented.
- [ ] No vendor binaries, firmware, personal backups, signing material, or generated output is included.
- [ ] Compatibility, safety, research provenance, and changelog docs were updated where applicable.
